retired.question: What was the name of Walt Disney's first studio, co-founded with his brother Roy?

retained.question: In what year was the Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio founded?

rationale: 1177 already names Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio and asks its founding year. Retire the name-only question, whose first-studio premise also conflicts with earlier Kansas City work.

sources.evidence: Walt arrived in California in 1923; the brothers formed Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio. Steamboat Willie opened November 18, 1928, after two silent Mickey shorts.
sources.limitations: Primary institutional text inspected; no film or video viewing claimed.

sources.evidence: Laugh-O-gram Films was Walt's Kansas City company making fairy-tale shorts in 1922, before the California studio.
sources.limitations: Primary institutional text inspected; no film or video viewing claimed.

originalOptionAssessments.assessment: Disney Brothers Cartoon Studio is the brothers' 1923 company, but not Walt's first studio overall.
Walt Disney Productions is a later company name, not the original 1923 name.
Laugh-O-gram predates the California company, exposing the first-studio ambiguity; the with-Roy qualifier does not make first-studio generally true.
Mickey Mouse Studios is not the original company name.
